sentences.text: Researchers developed an open system for rapidly testing brain-computer interfaces and neuromodulation methods using a three-part approach that included benchtop testing, long-term animal studies, and a human demonstration with external leads.

Benchtop tests measured technical factors like recording noise, while five dogs implanted with the device showed stable recordings for up to three years, successfully performing functions such as decoding thoughts and detecting epilepsy signs more than two years after implantation.

A single human participant used the benchtop version to control a cursor, and the authors provided public access to surgical methods, data, and software to assist other researchers in repeating the work.
